# Jugnu (Jugnu)

> Free, ad-free, privacy-first CBSE Class 1 learning web app (`https://www.jugnu.fun`) featuring Olympiad practice quizzes, interactive letter/number/word tracing, a multi-brush drawing board, printable A4 worksheets, and educational games for young children (ages 5–7). No logins, accounts, or tracking cookies required.

For a complete, detailed reference of all topics, question counts, FAQs, and guides, see [llms-full.txt](https://www.jugnu.fun/llms-full.txt).

## Olympiad Practice (CBSE Class 1)
- [Home](https://www.jugnu.fun/): Overview of Class 1 English topics, Subject Catalog, and quick start into Practice or Exam modes.
- [English Olympiad Practice](https://www.jugnu.fun/topics/english): 120 questions across Vocabulary, Grammar, Spelling, Reading Comprehension, Sentence Formation, Opposites, and Mock Practice Papers.
- [Mathematics Olympiad Practice](https://www.jugnu.fun/topics/mathematics): Numbers, shapes, addition, and word puzzles for Class 1.
- [Science Olympiad Practice](https://www.jugnu.fun/topics/science): 100 questions covering living things, plants, animals, the human body, and earth.
- [General Knowledge Practice](https://www.jugnu.fun/topics/general-knowledge): World facts, flags, festivals, seasons, and general awareness.

## Creative Drawing, Tracing & Worksheets
- [Drawing Board & Tracing Worksheets](https://www.jugnu.fun/drawing-board): Four modes — Trace (single large guide), Free Draw (blank canvas + temporary trace-image upload with size/rotation/opacity), Gods (deity coloring studio with fill & brushes), and Worksheet (6-row repeated practice sheets). Supports JPG and PDF export.
- [Learning Tools](https://www.jugnu.fun/learning-tools): Custom A4 printable tracing pack generator and mistake-revision quiz builder.
- [Help a Seed Grow](https://www.jugnu.fun/explore/seed): Short guided nature and tracing activity on how seeds grow.

## Educational Kids Games
- [Games Catalog](https://www.jugnu.fun/games): Curated ad-free mini-games for young learners.
- [Hanuman Run](https://www.jugnu.fun/games/hanuman-runner): Endless runner adventure with Classic and 3D clay artwork, power-ups, and keyboard/touch controls.
- [Sliding Picture Puzzle](https://www.jugnu.fun/games/sliding-puzzle): 3×3, 4×4, and 5×5 tile puzzles across 12 children's illustrations with optional picture hints.

## Guides, Trust & Support
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.jugnu.fun/information/faq): Answers on tracing, iPad/Apple Pencil support, brushes, local storage, and exports.
- [Parent's Guide](https://www.jugnu.fun/information/parent-guide): Tips for short, supported Class 1 practice and tracing sessions.
- [About Jugnu](https://www.jugnu.fun/about): Core principles (Zero Data Collection, Instant Access, Client-Side Memory, Children's Book Design).
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.jugnu.fun/information/privacy)
- [Terms of Use](https://www.jugnu.fun/information/terms)
- [Educational Disclaimer](https://www.jugnu.fun/information/disclaimer)
- [Contact](https://www.jugnu.fun/contact)
